name: Steakhouse Prime EURCV
oneLiner: steakEURCV is Steakhouse’s Morpho V2 EURCV lending vault; shares accrue yield, absorb strategy losses, and redeem against available liquidity.
collateral: EURCV held idle in the exact Morpho VaultV2 and supplied through its sole MorphoMarketV1 adapter; borrower collateral and market liquidity determine strategy risk.
pegMechanism: ERC-4626 shares represent a proportional EURCV-denominated lending position. Interest and fee-share accrual change assets per share; bad debt reduces NAV. Holder withdrawals burn shares and pay EURCV atomically when idle assets plus the selected liquidity adapter suffice. VaultV2 maxWithdraw and maxRedeem deliberately return zero as conservative underestimates, not measurements of available exit liquidity. At the reviewed pin, the current adapter's force-deallocation penalty is 0.001% of assets deallocated; this separate route still requires market liquidity and is not an ordinary withdrawal fee.

mechanismArchetypeReview.rationale: The exact immutable Ethereum VaultV2 share represents a EURCV-denominated strategy position, not direct ownership of the parent fiat reserves. At block 26197300 (2026-10-15T10:25:11Z), asset() is EURCV, share and underlying decimals are 18, and the sole adapter holds nine funded Morpho lender positions. Source-matched enter() pulls assets before user mint; accrueInterest() can mint fee shares and realizes strategy losses; exit() burns shares for available EURCV. Parent fiat-cash protections remain upstream.
